::: {.why}
The construction details decide the numbers, and knowing them is what lets you tell a replication failure from a specification difference when you rebuild these in phase 6.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Describe the size and value factor construction in enough detail to rebuild it: sort, breakpoints, weighting, rebalance date.
- Report the three-factor time-series regression for your test portfolios, including whether the intercepts are jointly zero.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>65 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Read the construction section of Fama and French 1993 and write the procedure as a numbered recipe. The June rebalance, the NYSE breakpoints and the value weighting inside each bucket are the three details most often got wrong.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Run the time-series regressions on the 25 portfolios and report the alphas with standard errors. Then run the joint test that all 25 intercepts are zero, which is the actual test of the model, and state the conclusion.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [10 min]{.task-min} Note the sample dependence: rerun the joint test on the post-2005 subsample and compare. The result will be different and that difference is the subject of day 115.
:::
:::
